ios.desc:
PurePlates: Your Recipe, Simplified

PurePlates is the ultimate recipe companion that cuts through the clutter and gets straight to what matters - the recipe. With our powerful extraction tool, you can easily save and access your favorite recipes from across the web, all in one clean, easy-to-use app.

Extract popular recipes like Gordon Ramsay's Beef Wellington or that perfect chocolate chip cookie recipe you found online that looks too good to pass up.

Key Features:
• Simple Recipe Extraction: Just share a recipe URL to the app or paste it directly. PurePlates does the rest, pulling out only the essential information.
• Clean Recipe View: See ingredients, instructions, and other crucial details without the distractions of ads or long stories.
• Favorites Collection: Easily save and organize your go-to recipes for quick access anytime.
• Clutter-Free Cooking Mode: Follow recipes step by step with our unique cooking mode. No more scrolling or screen timeouts while your hands are busy.

With PurePlates, you'll experience:
• A streamlined cooking process from recipe discovery to the final dish
• Easy-to-read recipe formats that highlight what's important
• A growing personal collection of your favorite recipes from around the web
• Stress-free cooking with our guided, distraction-free cooking mode

Whether you're attempting Gordon Ramsay's signature dishes or trying out that intriguing recipe you stumbled upon last night, PurePlates is designed to make your culinary journey smoother and more enjoyable. Say goodbye to endless scrolling and hello to pure, straightforward recipes.

Download PurePlates now and transform the way you cook. From web to plate, we've got you covered!

quotes.text:
Hey Everyone!

This is my first post on Hacker News, and I wanted to share my project with you! From a young age, I dreamed of becoming a chef, but life took me down the path of software engineering instead. Nevertheless, my passion for creating delicious meals has always remained close to my heart. This journey led me to seek out recipes to enhance my cooking skills, but I often found myself frustrated by the websites I encountered—ads everywhere, walls of text, and recipes that were difficult to follow.

That’s where PurePlates comes in. PurePlates allows users to share a recipe through their mobile browser or simply copy and paste the URL directly into the app. In an instant, you receive a scraped recipe that includes instructions, ingredients, and any available nutrition information. You can easily start cooking and follow along step by step, making the process much more enjoyable. Plus, if you find a recipe you love, you can add it to your favorites for quick access later!

As this is just an MVP, there’s still plenty of room for improvement, and I’m actively working on enhancing the extraction rate for recipes.

Thanks for reading, and keep hacking!
Connor
